articles.title: Dodgers - Pirates: Standings of both teams and results prior to this weekend's games
articles.standfirst: Los Angeles welcomes Paul Skenes and the rest of the Pirates at home
articles.summary: Los Angeles welcomes Paul Skenes and the rest of the Pirates at home
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Dodgers and the Pittsburgh Pirates face off this Friday at Dodger Stadium, in an interleague matchup featuring two teams heading in opposite directions.

The first pitch is scheduled for this August 21 at Los Angeles' iconic stadium , which has a capacity of 56,000 fans. The Boys in Blue come in red-hot; the Buccos are looking to pull off an upset away from home.

How do Dodgers - Pirates enter the weekend series? Latest results and standings in the table

The overall standings photo sums up the disparity. The Dodgers rank third in Major League Baseball with a record of 77 wins and 51 losses , while also leading the National League West Division. Their offensive production is one of the most fearsome in the league: 640 runs scored, just below the leader in that category, with a +145 run differential that speaks to a dominant team on both sides of the game.

On the other side, Pittsburgh is having a season of resilience. The Pirates are in 16th place overall with a record of 63 wins and 66 losses , and they are fourth in the National League Central Division. Even so, they are not a harmless opponent: they have produced 646 runs, even more than the Dodgers themselves, although their pitching (615 runs allowed) has cost them that difference that separates a contender from a middle-of-the-pack team.

The Dodgers stumbled into August — a tough stretch against the Boston Red Sox and Chicago Cubs slowed them down —, but they have regained their stride emphatically . They are coming off a sweep of the Colorado Rockies in Denver with 11-5, 7-6, and 6-4 victories, and before that they had taken care of the Kansas City Royals in a three-win series (6-5, 5-4, and 4-2). The Los Angeles bats roared back to life in Colorado, a worrying sign for any starting pitcher who comes to face them.

Pittsburgh, for its part, has shown inconsistency, but also flashes of danger. The Buccaneers closed their most recent series by winning two of three against the Detroit Tigers at home (4-1 and 4-3 after falling 5-8). Their offense is all or nothing: in recent weeks they crushed Miami 13-1 and the New York Mets 9-0, but they were also shut out and routed 0-11 by the Cubs and 1-11 by the Mets. When their pitching holds up, they can beat anyone; when it does not, blowout losses start piling up.

The matchup within the matchup: possible lineups for Dodgers - Pirates

The great attraction of this series is the Dodgers' arsenal of arms against Pittsburgh's jewel. Los Angeles rolls out a luxury rotation led by the Japanese pitchers Yoshinobu Yamamoto and Roki Sasaki , accompanied by left-handers Blake Snell and veteran Tyler Glasnow, all capable of dominating any lineup. In the bullpen, the presence of Edwin Díaz, Tanner Scott, and Blake Treinen gives Los Angeles an elite late-game finish to protect late leads.

Pittsburgh hangs much of its hopes on Paul Skenes , the 24-year-old starter who has become the reason to buy a ticket every time he takes the mound. Behind him, youngsters like Jared Jones and Bubba Chandler, along with the experienced Mitch Keller, make up a rotation with rising talent. The problem for the Buccaneers is depth: against a lineup like the Dodgers', a single stumble from the bullpen —where Gregory Soto and David... sorry, Chris Devenski stand out— can cost them the game.

Pittsburgh Offense: Ozuna, the heavy hitter

Although the Pirates do not have Los Angeles' offensive depth, they do have hitters capable of punishing mistakes. The 35-year-old Dominican designated hitter Marcell Ozuna brings power and experience to the heart of the lineup, while catcher Henry Davis and Dominican catcher Endy Rodríguez add youth behind the plate .

That production of 646 runs in the season shows that, when they connect, the Pirates can turn any game into a slugging battle.

Implications for the Playoff and World Series race

For the Dodgers, every win counts in their fight for the lead in the National League West Division , where they already hold a comfortable advantage, and in the chase for the top overall spot currently held by the Milwaukee Brewers (78-49). With only a one-game difference compared to Milwaukee in the overall standings, Los Angeles cannot afford to give away games at home against theoretically inferior opponents.

For Pittsburgh, October math is an uphill battle: with a losing record and in 16th place, the regular season has become a showcase for its young core looking ahead to the future. A victory at Dodger Stadium, however, would serve as a statement of intent for a project that is still being built around Skenes.

Players to watch during the Dodgers - Pirates

Yoshinobu Yamamoto (Dodgers) : the Japanese ace is the kind of starter who can silence Pittsburgh's offense for seven innings.

Paul Skenes (Pirates) : the number one reason not to take your eyes off the screen; his arm is capable of stealing a game from anyone, even the home favorites.

Marcell Ozuna (Pirates) : if the Pirates are going to trouble the Dodgers, his bat in key moments will be the key.

articles.title: Dodgers - Pirates Predictions: Match Favorite and Game Odds
articles.standfirst: Based on statistics and their position in the standings, the Dodgers are the favorites for the matchup
articles.summary: Based on statistics and their position in the standings, the Dodgers are the favorites for the matchup
articles.body:
There aren’t many ways to sugarcoat it: t his is a clash between a genuine World Series contender and a team fighting not to sink . The Los Angeles Dodgers are in second place in the National League and first in the West Division with a record of 77 wins and 51 losses.

On the other side, the Pittsburgh Pirates are in tenth place in the National League and fourth in the Central Division , with a 63-66 record. The difference in caliber between the two rosters is evident, and with the game being played in Los Angeles, the balance tilts even more toward the home team.

Dodgers - Pirates: Which team is favored to win and what position are they in the standings?

The heart of Los Angeles, Dodger Stadium welcomes a Pittsburgh Pirates team arriving at Chavez Ravine rowing against the current. Our read is clear and highly confident: the Dodgers impose their offensive power and elite rotation. We’re going with a 6-3 Dodgers win.

The Dodgers come in on a roll. On their most recent road trip they swept the Colorado Rockies with a devastating streak: 11-5, 7-6, and 6-4, three straight wins that reflect an offense that shows no mercy.

Overall, Los Angeles has scored 640 runs this season, one of the highest totals in the entire league, while its pitching has allowed just 495 , for a run differential of +145, the best in the National League behind Milwaukee. That balance between devastating hitting and reliable pitching is the hallmark of a contender.

The Pirates, on the other hand, live off short streaks. They are coming off taking the series against the Detroit Tigers at home (4-1 and 4-3 after falling 5-8 in the opener), which speaks to a team capable of striking when its timing is working.

Pittsburgh has scored 646 runs—surprisingly healthy production—but its problem is on the other side of the diamond: it has allowed 615, for a run differential of just +31. Its bullpen falls apart in high-leverage moments , and that, in a park like Dodger Stadium, usually comes at a high cost.

Pre-game betting market analysis for Dodgers - Pirates

The odds market for this matchup had not yet opened at the time of this analysis, s omething common when the game is one day away .

Even so, our own projection is clear-cut: given the home-field advantage, the run differential (+145 versus +31) and the superiority of the Los Angeles pitching staff, the Dodgers should open as heavy favorites on the money line.

When the board opens, we expect short prices for Los Angeles, and that's where it's worth looking at higher-value alternatives like the run line or the total.

Detailed prediction for the first Dodgers - Pirates game

We expect a game in which the Dodgers take control with early hitting. Their lineup has the depth to exploit any rough patch in the Pirates' bullpen , which has been their Achilles' heel all season.

We see Los Angeles scoring in spurts— a couple of early runs that force Pittsburgh to play from behind —and its pitching managing the lead into the final innings.

The Pirates are not harmless: with Ozuna and Davis they can hit the long ball and get closer . That’s why we’re not projecting a shutout, but rather a score with runs from both sides.

Our projected score is Dodgers 6-3, a result that reflects both the home team's dominance and the visitors' offensive ability to make the scoreline more respectable. With nine combined runs projected, the game points toward the high side (Over) on a total set around 8.5 runs, and we expect Los Angeles to cover the -1.5 run line.

Los Angeles Dodgers on the moneyline. It’s the strongest pick on the board: the superior team, at home, with a better rotation, better bullpen, and better run differential , against an opponent with inconsistent relief pitching. When the market opens, take it even at a short price.

Alternative bets for the Dodgers - Pirates

Dodgers -1.5 on the run line . If we expect Los Angeles to win convincingly and score in bunches, laying the run and a half adds value over an expensive moneyline. Ideal if you're looking for more generous odds.

Over on the total runs (around 8.5) . Pittsburgh's bullpen allows runs in bunches, and the Dodgers' offense is one of the most productive in the league. Our projected 6-3 score pushes this game over the line.

articles.title: Yankees - Blue Jays Predictions: Who will win the game and what are the odds for the matchup?
articles.standfirst: The story could be different from what happened last week in Toronto
articles.summary: The story could be different from what happened last week in Toronto
articles.body:
The New York Yankees host the Toronto Blue Jays at Yankee Stadium in the Bronx, New York, and all signs point to the home team extending their great run . With medium-high confidence, our pick is that the Yankees win the game: we’re calling it 3-1 in favor of New York.

The New York pitching has been solid and the team left Baltimore with two wins that confirm they are in their best form of the season.

What are the Yankees' and Blue Jays' standings in MLB?

The contrast in the overall MLB 2026 standings is evident. The Yankees are in sixth place with a record of 71 wins and 55 losses , and they are second in the American League East, only behind Tampa Bay.

Toronto, meanwhile, ranks 18th overall at 62 wins and 66 losses, sitting 4th in the East Division with a negative run differential of -53, one of the worst among teams with aspirations.

Recent form reinforces the trend. New York comes in having swept practically everything it has touched : wins over the Orioles by 3-1 and 5-3, and before that victories by 4-1 and 10-5 against Seattle. The Bronx Bombers have won four of their last five games.

The key piece of data, however, is the most recent head-to-head. These same teams faced each other just a few days ago in Toronto, and the Blue Jays won the first two games of that series (3-1 and 4-1) before New York responded with a 4-3 win in the finale . In other words, Toronto knows how to put the screws to the Yankees' pitching. But now the setting changes: the game is in the Bronx, where the Yankees have been especially solid.

Offensively, Toronto has shown brutal ups and downs: it thrashed Tampa Bay 10-5 and the next day lost 6-7 , then went on to win 3-1. It is a team of short streaks, not very consistent, just the opposite of the New York squad in this stretch.

Market betting analysis for the Yankees - Blue Jays

The matchup has not yet appeared on the sportsbook board at the time of writing, so there is no moneyline, total (over/under), or run line posted to cite.

When the market opens, the reading of this analysis will be clear: with the Yankees at home , in great form and with a better overall and divisional record, they should come out as clear favorites on the money line.

The value, in our opinion, will be on New York’s side to win, while Toronto’s offensive volatility opens the door to considering the -1.5 run line if the price is attractive.

Detailed forecast for the Yankees - Blue Jays game

We expect a game controlled by the Yankees, though not a walk in the park. We reset the projected score to 3-1 in favor of New York. The idea is for the home team's starting pitching to keep a Toronto offense in check that produces in spurts and that, when it cools off, barely scratches out one or two runs (just as the 1-3 and 1-4 losses New York suffered in Toronto could be repeated in reverse in the Bronx).

New York's game plan is to get ahead early and let the bullpen — with Bednar and Doval at the back end — shut the door. Toronto will have to rely on a big day from its starter to stay close ; if the game reaches the late innings with New York ahead, the depth of the home team's relief tilts the balance.

Regarding the scoring expectation, we project a game of moderate production, around 7-8 combined runs, leaning closer to an under if both starters deliver. With our 3-1, the Yankees would cover a possible -1.5 run line by a two-run margin, although that is the tightest scenario in our projection.

Yankees - Blue Jays: Main bet and alternatives for the game

Yankees on the moneyline (game winner). It is the strongest play : better record, better recent form, home-field advantage in the Bronx, and deeper pitching. We recommend it at whatever home-favorite price the market offers when it opens.

Under on the total runs (expect the line around 8.0-8.5): with top-tier starters on both sides and Toronto’s offense in intermittent mode, a low-tempo game makes sense.

Yankees run line -1.5: for those seeking better odds, backed by our prediction of a home win by two runs (3-1). It is the higher-risk option but also the one with the greatest value if the price is right.
